definitions.actual_window_switch: adjacent public events with different windows
definitions.consistency: A_task and B_rollout matched by mode, fixture_index and case_id; rates use aligned event pairs
definitions.latest_selection: max(fresh_count, kind_rank, path), with continued=100, guard32=32, guard16=16, primary=0
definitions.missing_to_window_switch: adjacent public transition whose previous event is missing and whose window changes
definitions.public_event: event with mapping-valued public and action; no-witness native rows excluded
definitions.public_recovery: each contiguous missing run followed by the next detected public event; unresolved terminal runs are not recoveries
definitions.same_pose: same window, xy_m and yaw_rad rounded to 6 decimal places
definitions.same_pose_caveat: repeat counts are observational proxies; repeated acquisition may carry information and is not labeled useless
definitions.same_pose_repeat_proxy: adjacent public transition whose previous event is missing and whose canonical pose is unchanged
definitions.window_return_proxy: public A-to-B-to-A triplet, counted on the B-to-A transition

b_vs_a_task.event_denominator_definition: sum over matched fixture/case episodes of min(A_task public event count, B public event count)
sum over matched fixture/case episodes of min(A_task public event count, B public event count)
